description: This Java class provides JWT token generation and validation services, including methods for creating access and refresh tokens, extracting usernames from tokens, and validating token integrity within a Spring Framework application.

classes.name: JwtService
classes.description: A Spring service class responsible for creating and validating JSON Web Tokens (JWT) for user authentication.

methods.name: getSigningKey
methods.description: Generates the cryptographic signing key from the secret string.

methods.name: generateAccessToken
methods.description: Creates a JWT access token with specified username and claims, expiring after configured duration.

methods.name: generateRefreshToken
methods.description: Creates a JWT refresh token with the specified username.

methods.name: buildToken
methods.description: Internal method to build and sign a JWT with claims, subject, and expiration.

methods.name: extractUsername
methods.description: Extracts the username (subject) claim from the given token.

methods.name: isTokenValid
methods.description: Validates whether the token is valid for the given username and not expired.

methods.name: isTokenExpired
methods.description: Checks if the token has expired based on its expiration claim.

methods.name: extractExpiration
methods.description: Extracts the expiration date from the token.

methods.name: extractClaim
methods.description: Generic method to extract any claim from the token using a resolver function.
